messages.content: Provide me with all the configured websites. My API is called YOUR_API_KEY

function.name: website_configuration_api_get_websites
function.description: Retrieves a list of website configurations currently set in the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

api_key.description: The API key used to authenticate the request.

status_filter.description: Filter the list of websites by their status.

include_details.description: Determines if detailed information for each website should be included in the response.

function.name: ApplicationSettingsApi_get_service_configs
function.description: Retrieve the configuration settings for all services managed by the application. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

service_name.description: The name of the service to filter the configurations. If omitted, configurations for all services are returned.

include_sensitive.description: Flag to determine if sensitive information such as passwords or tokens should be included in the configurations.

function.name: ApplicationSettingsApi_get_application_configs
function.description: Retrieve all configuration settings for the application. This includes settings such as feature toggles, system behaviors, and user preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

environment.description: The application environment for which the configurations are to be fetched, e.g., 'production', 'staging', or 'development'.

include_sensitive.description: Flag to determine if sensitive configurations such as API keys and passwords should be included in the response.
